title: Every R&D agent mapped and checked by sync-check, and a UI review against Claude Code desktop and Codex
request: The owner's goal (the stop hook): show that every R&D agent works behind the chat, and review the UI against Codex and Claude Code.
plan: map each of R&D's AGENTS to how the chat reaches it, or why not
sync-check lists R&D's agents and fails on an unmapped one or a way R&D no longer has
screens of the app's main views in Chromium
a side-by-side review with the gaps

decisions.decision: The map lives in dclab-code (sync/agents.json), R&D's list is read live
decisions.why: a new R&D agent must fail the check until someone decides how the chat reaches it

change: dclab-code sync/agents.json, server/rd.js (agentChanges), scripts/sync-check.js, web/index.html and web/style.css (the hint, the DCLab panel), docs/UI_REVIEW.md, docs/screens/review-*.png, tests.

findings.defect: the message box's hint wrapped onto five lines
findings.scenario: 1280 px window, after the Effort menu was added
findings.cause: the hint had no nowrap and hid only below 560 px of box
findings.fix: a short one-line hint, hidden below 760 px of box

findings.defect: the DCLab panel read in monospace and its stage chips were spread and shifted
findings.cause: the drawer's mono font for diffs; a global .done rule's auto margins on the done chips
findings.fix: the panel's cards in the page's font; the chips' own margin

findings.defect: nothing showed that every R&D agent is reached by the chat
findings.cause: the table in PARITY_PLAN was written by hand and checked by nobody
findings.fix: sync/agents.json and sync-check's agent check against R&D's live AGENTS list, tools, routes and modules
findings.test: dclab-code units (a new agent fails; a removed route, module or agent fails)

measurements.name: sync-check on the real R&D
measurements.result: In sync with R&D 50d90403 (on GitHub): 18 R&D agents, each reached or explained

outcome: Every R&D agent is reached or explained, checked on every sync; the UI's gaps against Claude Code and Codex are written down with what to build next.
lessons: A parity table nobody checks drifts: make the check part of the sync.
Look at the app after adding a control: the row it joins may no longer fit.
risks: the preview pane, cloud sessions, plugin marketplace and MCP management screen are not built
